acceptance: The gate accepts an engine argument and builds the Polars adapter with it
A test shows the gate's collects carry the requested engine argument
Existing gate behaviour and output are unchanged when no engine is given
description: build_production_contexts constructs each adapter with no options, so the gate always runs polars-df with engine=default. To exercise another engine, the only lever is POLARS_ENGINE_AFFINITY. Probed on 2026-10-08, the variable changes the engine from Polars 1.31.0 on (the streaming engine's `polars-stream` log lines appear only with it set to streaming), and has no effect on 1.0.0, 1.12.0 and 1.22.0. Let the gate take the engine as an option and pass it to the adapter, so the check uses the same code path as `benchbox run --platform-option engine=...` and works on every supported version that accepts the engine.
